normalized_tortoise.outgoing_wave: Psi ~ exp(-i Omega_inf (T - R_*)), Omega_inf = omega/sqrt(f_inf)

pole_invariance.statement: A constant time rescaling cannot change physical poles, only their frequency label: Omega_inf = omega / sqrt(f_inf). The resonance solver MUST report frequencies in the normalized time T to be comparable with a flat-infinity observer; reporting raw omega would masquerade the lapse as a spectral shift.
pole_invariance.convention_declared: All CERTIFIED_RESONANCE_CATALOG_V1 frequencies are Omega_inf in T-time; raw t-time omega is stored separately as omega_t.

G4_asymptotic.note: G4_inf ~ 0.49917 vs GR's 1/2: a ~0.17% shift in the asymptotic effective Planck mass. Metric is flat but the coupling constant carries the branch signature.

status_change: supersedes REGULAR_FINITE_LIMIT_EXTERIOR_NOT_FLAT from V4_GLOBAL_EXTERIOR_V1: the exterior is flat up to time normalization; c_inf = 0.501 was the COORDINATE speed dr/dt, not a new physical propagation speed (dr/dT = 1).
